spec_match.rationale: Values and expectations come from CSS Values 5 sections 9.2 to 9.4 and the random-item web-platform-tests; the probe sets the exact random-item() value and reads getComputedStyle().

interactive.rationale: Controls change the key, items or draw and the live readout updates on every action.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index blurb and page.json describe what this page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Native edge cases cannot run in any Chrome yet; the page states this and exercises the fallback edges.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5168050646155264, the spec section and CL 8816057.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level conformance.json (15 assertions from the spec and WPT): 0/15 pass on Chrome 158, as expected with no implementation, and none passes vacuously. Not yet run against a native implementation.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Exercised with Playwright on headless Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800, every control clicked, zero console errors and no failed requests after the final edit. Not verified with chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable in the cloud routine) and not verified natively (no Chrome build has random-item()).

telemetry_health.rationale: Calls showcaseTelemetry.support once from the exact-surface probe and asserts the primary contract after each interaction.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css for text and backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, selects and inputs with labels, 44px targets, role=status readouts, text equivalents for visual output. Accessibility tree not inspected (no DevTools MCP).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow and all controls usable at 360x740 and 1280x800.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify natively once CL 8816057 lands
openQuestions.detail: Run every concept in Canary with --enable-blink-features=CSSRandomItemFunction and check the native lanes and conformance suite, then update Findings and page.json results.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible labelled select and textarea input for a code playground
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible labels wrapping native controls; results announced in a status region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native select and textarea inside labels; results go to a role=status readout.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Readout updated after Parse and compute and after Try the var() trap in the Playwright run.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle button group aria-pressed filter table rows
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons; expose toggle state with aria-pressed and keep it in sync.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Filter buttons are native buttons in a labelled group with aria-pressed kept in sync; filtered rows use the hidden attribute.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Clicking 'Computed value' set aria-pressed=true on it and false on the others.
